LOOK: Motorists experience light to moderate traffic along EDSA Taft in Pasay on Monday, June 16. 

The Department of Health supports the proposed 30 km/h speed limit due to the rising number of road accidents, now the leading cause of death among young Filipinos.

📷: John Louie Abrina | MB
